recipe_with_top_pool.step: Sellers into the router
recipe_with_top_pool.why: On Aero (Aerodrome and Velodrome, merged) a swap pays the router, and the router pays on. These are the payers whose swaps name the router 0x72e46c9edf828002fdbfdd0952419790576c0f18; the router is never the buyer.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE topology MATCH (s:Address)-[sw:SWAPPED]->(r:Address {address: "0x72e46c9edf828002fdbfdd0952419790576c0f18"}) WHERE NOT s:Pool RETURN s.address AS from_address, r.address AS to_address, labels(s) AS from_node_labels, sw.sold_asset AS sold_asset, sw.bought_asset AS bought_asset, sw.sold_usd AS sold_usd, sw.bought_usd AS bought_usd, sw.swap_count AS swap_count, sw.pools AS pools, sw.last_seen_height AS last_seen_height ORDER BY sw.sold_usd DESC LIMIT 25

recipe_with_top_pool.step: Sellers into the busiest pool
recipe_with_top_pool.why: The senders of 0x7615926023bb149f36095645c2a81dc367d39750 on FLOWED_TO. A sender that also adds liquidity is a liquidity provider, not a seller.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE topology MATCH (s:Address)-[f:FLOWED_TO]->(p:Address {address: "0x7615926023bb149f36095645c2a81dc367d39750"}) WHERE NOT s:Pool RETURN s.address AS from_address, p.address AS to_address, labels(s) AS from_node_labels, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, s.labels AS from_labels, p.labels AS to_labels, s.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, p.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

recipe_with_top_pool.step: The day of a swap link
recipe_with_top_pool.why: A SWAPPED link carries heights, not times: read the block of its last_seen_height for the day the facts reads need.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE chain MATCH (b:Block {block_height: <last_seen_height>}) RETURN b.block_date, b.block_timestamp

recipe_with_top_pool.step: A seller's swaps through the router on one day

recipe_with_top_pool.step: Who the router paid in that transaction
recipe_with_top_pool.why: Fill the day and the tx_id: the receiver of the bought asset is the buyer. A pool or a pool manager there is the next leg, not the buyer.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE facts MATCH (r:Address {address: "0x72e46c9edf828002fdbfdd0952419790576c0f18"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "<YYYY-MM-DD>" AND t.tx_id = "<tx_id>" RETURN r.address AS from_address, b.address AS to_address, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol, t.kind AS kind, t.tx_id AS tx_id LIMIT 10

recipe_with_top_pool.why: The senders of 0x7615926023bb149f36095645c2a81dc367d39750 on FLOWED_TO, by lifetime volume. A seller that is a contract is often an aggregator or a router: say "a contract".
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE topology MATCH (s:Address)-[f:FLOWED_TO]->(p:Address {address: "0x7615926023bb149f36095645c2a81dc367d39750"}) WHERE NOT s:Pool RETURN s.address AS from_address, p.address AS to_address, labels(s) AS from_node_labels, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, s.labels AS from_labels, p.labels AS to_labels, s.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, p.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

recipe_with_top_pool.step: Who a seller's swaps paid
recipe_with_top_pool.why: Fill a seller from the first step. Keep the rows whose pools hold the pool: the recipient is the buyer.

recipe_with_top_pool.step: The day of a swap link
recipe_with_top_pool.why: A SWAPPED link carries heights, not times: read the block of its last_seen_height for the day the facts reads need.

recipe_with_top_pool.step: The swaps the pool manager settles
recipe_with_top_pool.why: unnamed per-launch Uniswap v4 swap routers keeps every pool in one manager, 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951. A manager deploys nothing: its pools are the pools of the swaps it settles.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE topology MATCH (s:Address)-[sw:SWAPPED]->(r:Address {address: "0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951"}) WHERE NOT s:Pool RETURN s.address AS from_address, r.address AS to_address, labels(s) AS from_node_labels, sw.sold_asset AS sold_asset, sw.bought_asset AS bought_asset, sw.sold_usd AS sold_usd, sw.bought_usd AS bought_usd, sw.swap_count AS swap_count, sw.pools AS pools, sw.last_seen_height AS last_seen_height ORDER BY sw.sold_usd DESC LIMIT 25

recipe_with_top_pool.step: One seller's swaps
recipe_with_top_pool.why: Fill a seller from the first step. A recipient that is the manager is never the buyer: read the facts row past it.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE topology MATCH (s:Address {address: "<seller address>"})-[sw:SWAPPED]->(r:Address) RETURN s.address AS from_address, r.address AS to_address, labels(r) AS to_node_labels, sw.sold_asset AS sold_asset, sw.bought_asset AS bought_asset, sw.sold_usd AS sold_usd, sw.bought_usd AS bought_usd, sw.swap_count AS swap_count, sw.pools AS pools, sw.last_seen_height AS last_seen_height ORDER BY sw.swap_count DESC LIMIT 25

recipe_with_top_pool.step: The day of a swap link
recipe_with_top_pool.why: A SWAPPED link carries heights, not times: read the block of its last_seen_height for the day the facts reads need.
recipe_with_top_pool.query: USE chain MATCH (b:Block {block_height: <last_seen_height>}) RETURN b.block_date, b.block_timestamp
